# The nhm forms that lessons 05, 06, 07 and 20 and the swarm scripts will
# use once they switch from ntm (acfs-9hkh.27, acfs-9hkh.33): upstream's
# lesson forms with ntm renamed to nhm, and upstream's swarm argv.
# tests/unit/test_nhm_docs_conformance.py parses each one against nhm's
# real command tree (syntax only: no herdr server is reachable).
#
# A line is one form, or:
#   deferred <bead> <form>   a form nhm does not have yet; reported, not run
#   replaced <ntm form> => <nhm form>   ntm's form, and the nhm form a lesson uses instead
# Paths in forms are /dev/null where nhm reads a file.

# Lesson 05 (upstream 05_ntm_core.md)
nhm list
nhm send myproject "Analyze this codebase and summarize what it does"
nhm send myproject --cc "Focus on the API layer"
nhm send myproject --cod "Focus on the frontend"
nhm send test-session "Say hello and confirm you're working"
nhm spawn myproject --cc=2 --cod=1 --agy=1
nhm spawn test-session --cc=1 --no-cass-context
deferred acfs-9hkh.20 nhm attach myproject
deferred acfs-9hkh.18 nhm deps -v
deferred acfs-9hkh.18 nhm tutorial

# Lesson 06 (upstream 06_ntm_command_palette.md)
nhm palette --list
nhm palette --show fresh_review
nhm send myproject "Review the changes in src/ for edge cases"
nhm send myproject -t code_review --file /dev/null
replaced ntm template list => nhm palette --list

# Lesson 07 (upstream 07_flywheel_loop.md)
nhm --help
nhm spawn my-first-project --cc=2 --cod=1 --agy=1
nhm spawn myproject --cc=2 --cod=1
nhm send my-first-project "Let's build something awesome."

# Lesson 20 (upstream 20_newproj.md)
nhm spawn myapp --cc=2
deferred acfs-9hkh.20 nhm attach myapp

# The swarm scripts (upstream swarm_launch.sh, swarm_packet.sh, swarm_status.sh)
nhm --robot-spawn=demo --spawn-dir=/srv/projects/demo --spawn-cc=1 --spawn-cod=1 --spawn-no-user --spawn-safety --spawn-wait --timeout=60s --robot-format=json
nhm --robot-spawn=demo --spawn-dir=/srv/projects/demo --spawn-cc=1 --spawn-cod=1 --spawn-no-user --spawn-safety --spawn-wait --timeout=60s --robot-format=json --dry-run
nhm --robot-send=demo --panes=1.2 --type=codex --msg-file=- --op-id=packet-demo-0001 --robot-format=json --no-cass --with-memory=false
nhm --robot-send=demo --panes=1.2 --type=codex --msg-file=- --robot-format=json --no-cass --with-memory=false --dry-run
nhm --robot-send-receipt=packet-demo-0001 --robot-format=json
nhm --robot-status
nhm --robot-snapshot
